corrections.reason: In three italic quotations the print shows an empty missing-glyph box after "the Messenger of Allah" / "the Messenger". The box is the italic font's own missing-glyph shape: the PDF has glyph 0 of its embedded italic Times New Roman there, with no character code, so the PDF itself does not record what was typed. Everywhere else the book prints ﷺ in this position, always in the upright or bold face and never in italic, which fits the honorific failing to render in the italic font. The library shows ﷺ; the publisher should confirm.

evidence.pdfCharacter: (cid:0): glyph 0 (.notdef) of the embedded subset AAAABF+TimesNewRomanPS-ItalicMT, 12 pt, 9.34 pt wide; no Unicode mapping. These are the only three such characters in the PDF.
evidence.elsewhere: ﷺ occurs 155 times in the PDF: 150 in TimesNewRomanPSMT (two subsets) and 5 in TimesNewRomanPS-BoldMT; none in the italic face.
